info.title: Metrics API
info.description:
Scrape the Grounds metrics assigned to your API key in the Prometheus text format, with your own Prometheus or any tool that reads it.

**Each key returns only the metrics Grounds assigned to it.** You cannot send a query: the metrics are agreed with Grounds when the key is issued, and request parameters such as `?query=` or `?match[]=` are ignored. Ask your Grounds contact for a key and say which metrics you need.

**Keys are shown once.** Grounds stores only the key's SHA-256 hash, so a lost key cannot be recovered. To rotate, request a new key, switch to it, then ask Grounds to revoke the old one. Issuing and revoking a key takes effect within a few minutes.

**Rate limit:** 30 requests per minute per key, counted in fixed one-minute windows. A 15-second scrape interval uses 4; 30 or 60 seconds is usually enough.

### Scrape with Prometheus

Save the key in a file readable only by the user Prometheus runs as, then add:

```yaml
scrape_configs:
  - job_name: grounds
    scheme: https
    metrics_path: /v1/metrics
    scrape_interval: 60s
    honor_labels: true
    authorization:
      type: Bearer
      credentials_file: /etc/prometheus/grounds-metrics-key
    static_configs:
      - targets: ["api.grounds.gg"]
```

`honor_labels: true` keeps the labels Grounds sends as they are. In Prometheus, **Status → Targets** should show the `grounds` target as `UP`.

tags.name: Metrics
tags.description: Prometheus-format metrics scoped to your API key.

get.description:
Returns the metrics assigned to the key in the [Prometheus text exposition format](https://prometheus.io/docs/instrumenting/exposition_formats/#text-based-format), evaluated at request time.

- Each value is the latest sample Grounds holds for that series.
- A series whose newest sample is older than five minutes is left out. Treat a missing series as "no data", not as `0`.
- Every metric is `untyped`; there are no `# HELP` lines and no timestamps, so your scraper stamps samples with its own scrape time.
- The path is exact: `/v1/metrics/` with a trailing slash returns `404`. Only `GET` is allowed; other methods return `405` with `Allow: GET`.

200.description: The metrics assigned to your key. The names and labels in the example are illustrative.

text/plain; version=0.0.4; charset=utf-8.example:
# TYPE grounds_players_online untyped
grounds_players_online 128
# TYPE grounds_players_by_mode untyped
grounds_players_by_mode{mode="bedwars"} 40
grounds_players_by_mode{mode="duel"} 22

401.description: The `Authorization` header is missing, is not `Bearer <key>`, or the key is unknown or revoked. A newly issued key can take a few minutes to become active.

429.description: The key exceeded 30 requests in the current minute. Wait `Retry-After` seconds, then lengthen your scrape interval.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the current one-minute window ends.

502.description: Grounds could not evaluate one of your metrics. The whole response fails, so you never receive a partial set. Retry on your next scrape; if it persists, contact Grounds.

metricsKey.description: A metrics API key issued by Grounds, starting with `gmk_`. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.
